system.description:
What tales have you recorded in these well-worn pages?

  1. The benefits of Resourceful also trigger when you rest without a travel roll.

  2. When you make a discovery due to Treasure Hunter, you may perform an Insight check (Very Hard) with a bonus equal to your skill level in order to find an additional item.

  3. The benefits of Tavern Talk also trigger when you rest in the wilderness, though you must use Refreshments (which you gain the usage of).

  4. When you make a travel roll involving ships, you must perform an Insight/Willpower check (target 3). On a failure, your party will become shipwrecked.
